title: A track becomes its looping visual
pitch: A style of music in. An original track and a seamless moving picture cut to its length out.
why: Small models, small card. ACE-Step writes the track, Wan 2.2 makes five seconds of motion, FILM doubles the frames, and ffmpeg closes the seam and loops it for the length of the song.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Abstract motion loops best: ink, smoke, water, light.

94.tags: Slow ambient electronic, warm analog pads, soft pulse, deep and calm, no vocals

steps.label: The motion
steps.prompt: Macro photograph: thick plumes of deep blue and bright gold ink slowly billow and curl through clear water against a pure black background, sharp detail, soft studio light. The camera stays still.

steps.label: Close the seam
steps.does: Crossfades the end into the start, so it loops.

steps.label: Loop to the track
steps.does: Repeats the loop for the whole track.
